title: Content Asset
description: DC-003-I018 — the canonical, repository-owned production source. Not a Finished Carousel, an Article, a Topic Package, or an LLM prompt on its own — it is the approved envelope a Topic Package is embedded within, retrievable by asset_id from the Content Asset Repository (content-assets/). Deliberately small: no rendered slides, approval history, persistence metadata, or provider outputs belong here.

asset_id.description: Human-assigned, not machine-generated — unlike every other DC-003 identifier (topic_/car_/exec_/req_/...), a Content Asset's ID has no prefix convention. Must match the JSON filename exactly (content-assets/<asset_id>.json).

topic_package.description: A full Topic Package object, validated separately against topic-package.schema.json by the Content Asset Repository — not re-specified here, matching this codebase's existing convention of not duplicating one schema inside another (see README 'Schemas' for the same simplification applied to Carousel Content's per-slide fields).
